summary: Amendment 2026-11-28 item 2 (predictive imagination and multistep planning in decision-making). LatentPlanner searches imagined continuations of every candidate in the learned latent world model (transition + world-model goal values at imagined beliefs, coherent particles), reports information value; HorizonController value criterion; ImaginationCalibration learns the imagination weight of rule thompson_policy from verified multi-step windows; transition ensemble got zero-mean randomised priors (overconfidence defect); the ratio weight's amplification of unsupported imagination fixed. Imagination causally changes decisions on the runtime path (debug B2: share_tv 0.053, argmax changed 22/244); no reliable improvement measured; agent hook (change request IMP) applied by ST in dde7d2d.

AM2-1 multi-step rollouts of candidate s.limitations: continuations range over the current candidate set; exhaustive at the first imagined level within the row budget, greedy + random subset deeper

AM2-2 comparison of alternative approach.limitations: the best imagined continuation per first action is compared; its next action and the particles' agreement are recorded, the full imagined sequence is not

evidence: docs/IMP.md §2.2, §3.3 (info value > 0 for 66 % of chosen candidates in B2)
AM2-3 information value of experiments.limitations: recorded per candidate; exploration uses it only through Thompson sampling over particles; randomised experiments are still designed on one-step outcomes

AM2-4 selection on expected long-term va.state: implemented and integrated (change request IMP applied by ST in dde7d2d)
AM2-4 selection on expected long-term va.limitations: IMP's runs used HEAD + the CR diff on exported copies, before the integration commit

AM2-5 calibration gating of imagined val.limitations: verified multi-step windows are scarce (2-7 per seed and lifetime in T1)

AM2-6 horizon grows only as measured acc.limitations: the value criterion passes at both scales because imagination equals not imagining there (harmless, not informative); the latent criterion still never passes (KF-X10)

AM2-7 imagined consequences causally cha.state: verified at debug scale on the runtime path; full size: replay of live decisions
commands: PYTHONPATH=<HEAD + CR IMP> python -m cam_live.predict.imp_eval run --arm on|off --seed S --family T1 --lifetimes 6 --decisions 16

AM2-8 measured improvement in decisions.limitations: beta_im ~ 0 on the verified windows available; the delayed dependency was rarely experienced; batch stopped at 42 of 120 lifetimes by the CPU rule
